pulse: On day two of the build season, Cole builds the water system while Sawyer steps into real leadership, and the family finds its rhythm in summer's endless light—work, eat, work again.
scene: At midday, Cole and Sawyer mark the water line from the spring; Finn joins them from lessons, while Maggie and Bear set the table at the cabin porch, the endless summer sun bright and warm above.

day_summaries.1: Day one: Finn's instinct proved right, the spring flows clear on the ridge, and the family's first night settles warm with hot soup and plans. Water changes everything—Cole's already sketching the pipeline for tomorrow. They're exactly where they meant to be.

lean.label: Work the list
lean.desc: Tackle the cabin water system or foundation now—winter won't wait, and every hour of daylight counts.
